description: Default system prompt for hosted agents. Includes delegation instructions when delegation is enabled and schema instructions when the harness lacks native schema support.
Wraps the caller's message and any run parameters.
Task wrapper used when the caller is another agent.
Explains Garrison's delegation tools; included by system prompts when delegation is enabled.

Explains the fan-out tools (garrison_fan_out, garrison_gather, garrison_cancel_fan_out), join policies, and budgets; included by builtin/garrison-tools-instructions, so only when delegation is enabled (AD5.6).

Points the harness at the capability catalog tools (garrison_list_capabilities, garrison_describe_capability) and how to choose between agents, MCP tools, and host tools; included by builtin/garrison-tools-instructions, so only when delegation is enabled (AD4.7).

Explains the conversation file space: its mount path in the working directory, that files there persist across turns and are shared with delegated agents, and the garrison_files_* tools; included by system prompts when the run has a file space (AD3).
Lists the agent assets (skills, reference files, document templates) placed in the run's workspace; included by system prompts when a placement asks for a listing (AD2.3).
Output schema instructions for harnesses without native schema support.
Repair prompt sent when output fails schema validation.
Task prompt of a conversation turn that starts a fresh harness session because the original session could not be resumed: repeats the earlier turns, then the current task.

Task prompt of a pipeline stage run (P12.9): renders around the stage run's own task prompt (pipeline.task) and hands it the previous stage's output, structured output, artifact references, reviewer notes, and revision feedback.
Review feedback wording included by builtin/pipeline-stage when a stage runs again after a reviewer requested changes (P12.9).
Default run input of a trigger fire (P12.5): describes a cron occurrence, a webhook delivery with its payload, or a manual fire. A trigger's inputTemplateId replaces it.
Description of an agent exposed as its own MCP tool.
Description of an agent's A2A skill.
Claude Code --mcp-config JSON file.
Mux --mcp-config JSON file (bearer tokens referenced from the environment).
Mux endpoints.json rendered from deployment parameters (adapterType, baseUrl, timeoutMs, maxTokens) and model.
Mux settings.json for headless runs.
Mux subagents.json (no subagents).
Gemini CLI settings.json with MCP servers.
opencode config file named by OPENCODE_CONFIG: the system prompt as an instructions file, and MCP servers.
pi mcp.json in the run's private PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR; header and environment values are referenced from the environment.
Message a harness receives when Garrison denies a permission request (P12.3). A tenant template named approval-denied of kind Other replaces it for that tenant.
Optional provider API harness configuration, compiled from deployment parameters and resolved MCP servers.
Resumes a suspended harness session with reviewed permission decisions; configurable per tenant.
Renders the summary garrison_gather returns: the group's status and each member's result, error, and files written; configurable per tenant (AD5.6).
Requests a resumable harness to finish its current turn at a durable approval or child-wait checkpoint.

Default system prompt of the agent architect (AD7.6, AD-025): designs agents and apps in studio drafts and asks a person to approve applying them; composed of builtin/agent-architect-design and builtin/agent-architect-runtime. Clone it to change it.
Guided system prompt of the agent architect for first-time builders (AD7.6, AD-025): one question at a time, with each step explained. Clone it to change it.
Architect instructions for designing agents and apps in a studio draft: items, the app graph, capability choice, validation, and request-apply (AD7.6).
Architect instructions for deployment settings: harness, model, budget, timeouts, approval rules, and environments (AD7.7).
